name: Interactive Volume Illustration (Hatching)
definition: An interactive object-space technique for illustrating volumetric data by simulating free-hand line art (hatching) using hardware-assisted volume and line rendering, with data-driven seed point selection to minimize memory and generation time.
summary: Interactive Volume Illustration (Hatching) is an object-space technique that renders volumetric data as free-hand line art by tracing hatches along principal curvature directions, differing from mesh-based methods by computing silhouettes per-fragment using normal maps.
